turns.text: Good day and welcome to the earnings conference call.
Traffic was strong and we saw continued trade-down from higher-income shoppers. Consumer demand held up.
Comparable sales grew 4%. We managed inventory well with some destocking. Pricing was competitive with promotional activity in discretionary categories.
Are you seeing consumer weakness or more trade-down?
We see trade-down and value-seeking behavior, a sign of consumer caution. Inventory is healthy after destocking.
